notices.title: Water Shutdown Notice
notices.content: Water supply will be shut down on June 22, 2026 from 10 AM to 4 PM for pipeline maintenance. Residents are requested to store water in advance.

notices.title: Pest Control Schedule
notices.content: Society-wide pest control will be conducted on June 28, 2026. All residents must vacate common areas from 9 AM to 12 PM. Flat-level pest control is optional at ₹300 per flat.

notices.title: Parking Rule Enforcement
notices.content: Vehicles found parked in visitor slots beyond 2 hours will be towed at owner's expense. All residents must display parking stickers issued by the office.

notices.title: Gym Renovation Closure
notices.content: The gym will remain closed from June 25 to July 5, 2026 for flooring renovation. Swimming pool remains open during this period.
